note.ja: 流体と変形構造の結合の入口。構造の力・構成則が別途必要で、既存の非圧縮ソルバーだけで実装済みとはなりません。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Fluid coupled to a deformable structure; biological examples include valves and membranes, once a force/constitutive law is supplied. Immersed boundary is a numerical coupling method, not itself a closed biological constitutive equation. The existing periodic MAC solver does not implement this coupling. Literature-only.
